# Notice

This project is a modern Fortran translation of the computational code in
`quadprog` 1.5-8.

Original S code: Berwin A. Turlach.
R port: Andreas Weingessel.
LINPACK routines and contributions: Cleve Moler and upstream contributors.

The upstream package declares `GPL (>= 2)`. This translation is distributed as
GPL-2.0-or-later. Original source, metadata, tests, documentation, and GPL
license texts are retained under `original/quadprog-master/`.
